prompt: Responsive grid for cards and tiles.
shortDesc: Wayfarer layout: responsive grid that lays out its children (cards, tiles, list items) in as many columns as fit, each at least min-width wide; one column on phones. Use it for any group of cards instead of building a grid.

props.name: min-width
props.description: Minimum column width in px (default 220). Smaller = more columns.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items: tight, normal (default) or loose.

slots.accepts: any components, typically cards or tiles

styling.notes: Neutral: no colours of its own; items stretch to equal height per row.
